notes.title: Sand in a Box: Fire and Metal
notes.content:
[h1]Sand in a Box: Fire and Metal[/h1]

[h2]Four new elements[/h2]

● Lithium and Potassium — metals that can be unstable.
● Aluminium — a new lightweight solid, but with a relatively low melting point.
● Thermite — burns hot and can be a bit explosive.

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]

● "Metals" category is now properly defined.
● Added missing translations and images.
● Various improvements to particle definitions.
● Flammable property now works correctly, and some materials burn as they should!

notes.title: Jukebox Update
notes.content:
[h1]Sand in a Box: Jukebox Update![/h1]

[h3]Introducing... Music![/h3]

[list]
[*]13 new tracks to accompany your adventures.
[*]Jukebox where you can listen to the entire playlist.
[*]Enable your favorite tracks and disable the rest if you like.
[/list]

[h3]Add your own music[/h3]

[list]
[*] Like with many other features, Sand in a Box loads music dynamically.
[*] You can add your own tracks in OGG format to the Music folder.
[*] Path: [i]./Sand in a Box/Sand in a Box_Data/StreamingAssets/Music[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added missing translations from last update.
[*] Volume slider is now functional.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.55
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.55[/h1]

[h2]Introducing two new elements: Chlorine and Sodium[/h2]

[list]
[*]More realistic (and more dangerous!) saltwater electrolysis.
[*]Sodium and water? BOOM! Handle with care. 
[*]Chlorine is toxic — keep it away from plants and other living things. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]BUG FIX:[/b] Selecting elemental set or loading game state now works as intended.
[*]Minor improvements to physical set.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5: Save states are finally here!
notes.content:
[h1]Save and Load your game with ease[/h1]
[list]
[*]Save the state of your game at any moment—no more worrying about losing progress.
[*]Load and manage saves directly from a convenient list, complete with previews for quick access.
[/list]

[h1]Various improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Field Resizing:[/b] Resizing the field now retains the previous state. If you shrink the field, it will automatically crop to fit.
[*][b]Dynamic Aspect Ratio Support:[/b] Saves will seamlessly resize to fit different aspect ratios, ensuring compatibility across devices.
[*]Features like gravity and field-looping are now preserved when changing backgrounds or other settings.
[/list]

[h1]Early Access Reminder[/h1]
[h2]While Sand in a Box is still in Early Access, here are a few things to keep in mind:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Save file format may evolve to support new features as the game continues to grow.
[*]Automatic conversions will be provided when needed, but we cannot guarantee perfect compatibility during Early Access.
[*]Found a bug or lost data? Let us know on the Steam community page, and we'll work with you to resolve it.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4: Things that go BOOM!
notes.content:
[h1]Pressure system added to the simulation[/h1]
[list]
[*]Pressure now affects all particles.
[*]Large pressure differences can displace objects, even walls.
[*]This system will be fine-tuned in future updates.
[/list]

[h1]New particles:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamite[/b] - explodes after a short delay.
[*] [b]Black Powder[/b] - explodes when ignited, with a less powerful blast.
[*] [b]Nitroglycerin[/b] - highly unstable unless cooled to a more stable state.
[*] [b]Tetracene[/b] - detonates upon exposure to electricity.
[*] [b]Black Hole[/b] - consumes anything nearby.
[/list]

[h1]Various performance and stability improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Time rewind is now disabled by default on PCs with 4 GB RAM or less, but can be enabled manually in settings.
[*]Improved memory management reduces slowdowns on older PCs with time rewind enabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3: Play with time!
notes.content:
This is the first content update for Sand in a Box. We're introducing new ways to control the simulation:

[h2]Control the speed of the simulation:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pause and draw in a world without the pressure of flowing time.
[*]Run the simulation at different speeds: normal, 2x, and as fast as your CPU can handle.
[/list]

[h2]Rewind Time:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Press the rewind button to go back in time!
[*]Experiment freely, now you can undo everything.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements to the simulation:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Plutonium can now melt.
[*] Plutonium can become critical at very high temperatures.
[*] Fixed bug that did not draw some pixels of Plant (and other particles with 'absorb' property)
[/list]

Please note: The rewind feature significantly reduces performance and requires additional RAM. You can disable it in settings.

notes.title: Sand in a Box is a fresh modern 'falling sand' playground out now on Steam
notes.content:
Developer Patryk Zieliński of Tiliasoft just released Sand in a Box in Early Access on Steam, a fresh and new falling sand game with a lot of toys to play with.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/08/sand-in-a-box-is-a-fresh-modern-falling-sand-playground-out-now-on-steam
